# Work Log テンプレート(Issueコメント用)

```markdown
## Work Log

- Date: YYYY-MM-DD
- Task: #<issue-number>
- Work Type: Implementation | Review | Fix | Meeting | Research | Data Creation | Documentation | Testing | Incident Response | Other
- Summary: <作業内容の要約>
- Participants:
  - <Name>: <hours>h
  - <Name>: <hours>h
- Elapsed Time: <hours>h
- Spent: <total person-hours> person-hours
- AI Used: Yes | No
- AI Tool: <tool name or n/a>
- Result: <結果>
- Remaining Work: <残作業>
```

1人作業の簡易形式(正式記録は構造化形式を推奨):

```text
Spent <hours>h | YYYY-MM-DD | <Name> | <summary>
```

正式記録は `reports/effort/YYYY-MM.yaml` に構造化形式で残す
([work-logging](../operations/work-logging.md) 参照)。
